description: Records that must stay hidden from read surfaces. Every record mentions the probe topic and carries a unique marker. `forbidden` applies to every surface; `forbiddenOnChannelSurfaces` adds what a surface that can be delivered to a channel (the daily briefing) must not see. Private archive rows of the user's own workspace stay readable on the owner's own tool surface by design (MemoryService: private means not shared externally), so they are only forbidden on channel surfaces.
